title: Create a self-signed certificate
when: The step asks to create a new self-signed certificate in Certificate and Key Management, with a given label. The private key cannot be deployed, so every org needs it created by hand. It is not uploading a CA-signed certificate or importing a keystore, which need a file.
steps: In the embedded Certificate and Key Management page, click 'Create Self-Signed Certificate'.
Type the label the step gives into Label. Unique Name fills in by itself; leave it unless the step gives one.
Leave key size and the exportable-private-key option as offered, unless the step says otherwise.
doneWhen: The certificate's detail page, or the certificates list, shows a self-signed certificate with the requested label.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 3 actions, 21 s, reviewer confirmed; a fresh session showed the certificate in the list. Confirmed without any model: a Tooling API query on Certificate returned 'Autopilot Trial Cert'.

trial.step: Create a self-signed certificate labelled Autopilot Trial Cert.
